world: a corridor met once per trip: empty floor, chest, lamp, D levers (D varying by one from trip to trip), door, `length` cells in all so that every trip takes the same number of moments; pass (0) or interact (1) at each cell; the key sits in the chest under rule A and in the lamp under rule B; interacting at the door with the key pays +1 with probability `food` and ends the trip; interacting with the chest, the lamp or a lever when it holds no key costs `cost`; the floor has nothing to interact with; taking the key pays nothing; a share `truncation` of the trips is cut short before the door at a random cell, the key lost with it; the observation is the one-hot kind of the cell faced plus the pouch sense (key held), the blind arm without the pouch sense
life: one stream, no resets: rule A for `episodes` trips, then rule B for `episodes`; the outcome of the last cell of a trip is delivered with the first observation of the next trip, done set after the door (terminal) and clear after a cut (the forecast carries over); changes are unannounced

gates.statement: over the confirmation lives of the live arm at the gated delays, at least `share` end each rule with `fed` of their last 50 trips fed, waste at most `wrong` interactions per trip in the last 50 trips of each rule (below the uniform-random policy's at delay 2 and a third of the lazy interact-everywhere policy's), and spend no more than `aroused_late` of the second half of each rule aroused (one trip in twenty is cut, and each cut is a missed meal and a contradicted forecast). Delay 10 is reported without a gate. Second freeze: the first gated frugality at 0.5 and calm at 0.2, and its yoked arm crashed on trips cut to one cell.
